# maatify/cloudflare-turnstile

> PHP library that validates a Cloudflare Turnstile token on the server through the `siteverify` endpoint and reports the result, failing closed when a request cannot be sent or answered.

Consumer context: use the documents below as the supported contract. The Package Reference is the canonical stable public, runtime and behavioral contract and the complete Public Runtime API inventory; the Usage Guide and examples show how to use it. Visible in repository does not mean supported: do not treat `src/` internals, undocumented classes or methods, tests, fixtures, contributor-only files or internal engineering standards as a consumer contract. If the documents below do not support a claim, do not infer it from the implementation. Exact package facts (name, PHP and extension requirements, dependencies, autoloading) are owned by `composer.json`.

## Core documentation

- [Package Reference](CLOUDFLARE_TURNSTILE_PACKAGE_REFERENCE.md): canonical public/runtime/behavioral contract and complete Public Runtime API inventory.
- [Usage Guide](docs/guides/USAGE_GUIDE.md): integration workflows, inputs, results and boundaries.
- [README](README.md): package overview, installation, quick usage and Public Runtime API overview.
- [Examples](examples/): maintained examples that use the documented Public API.
- [composer.json](composer.json): exact package identity, requirements and autoloading.

## Release and support
